name: skill-heaven
description: Working prototype of Skill Heaven for Claude Code, actively tested for public use. One ladder, one line (off · low · med · high · xhigh · max · ultra) whose four surfaces are contiguous bands read from the current rung: off is /skill-zero (the product floor), low·med is /skill-heaven (converge), high·xhigh·max is /skill-hell (explore) — two directions of the same summon — and ultra is /skill-ultra, the crown rung and controller with no sub-ladder of its own. Per-rung counts are PROVISIONAL until the benchmark lands. Interfaces may change. The off-default launcher and standing-dose statusline live in the claude-zero package, run from a source checkout — not part of this marketplace install.
